## History

Gorham Pullen is a resident of [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) whose wife visited [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to offer mixed well-wishes to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) ahead of her upcoming marriage to [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P0](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P9](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P15](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P20](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0020)_

## Quotes

> "He was so small for his years upon his arrival here. Truly, I scarcely recognized him today. He is starting to resemble his father quite a bit."
>
> — Gorham Pullen — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P9](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0009)

> "I have no doubt that Odette will perform her duty"
>
> — Gorham Pullen — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003)

> "Is that not Cedric Stanhope who has become such a large boy?"
>
> — Gorham Pullen — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P9](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0009)

> "Indeed, I am uncertain"
>
> — Gorham Pullen — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P5](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0005)

> "So Hugh did not betray your trust in the end"
>
> — Gorham Pullen — [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P11](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0011)

## Relationships

### [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gorham-pullen--odette-pullen.md)

Gorham Pullen was saved by [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), with whom he shared a familial relationship that ended in Volume 3. [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) later visited [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) as part of a group offering mixed well-wishes for [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) Harcourt's upcoming wedding.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 ch.Time P6](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0006), +4 more_
